_about_snapshots: Non-candle readings, one JSON file each in data/snap/<name>.json, newest valid reading wins (older or invalid uploads are rejected, last good kept). task = who loads it: 'daily-tv' = the 11:30 Claude task (TV_TASK.md), 'coinglass' = the CoinGlass Claude task on the owner's computer (COINGLASS_TASK.md).

snap/tv_econ_us.what: US high-importance economic calendar, yesterday to +15 days (UTC)

snap/cmc_global.what: CoinMarketCap whole-market snapshot (Fear & Greed, Altcoin Season, market cap, dominance, ETF assets)

snap/coinglass_btc.what: CoinGlass BTC funding, open interest and liquidations (read in the browser)

snap/coinglass_eth.what: CoinGlass ETH funding, open interest and liquidations (read in the browser)

snap/cmc_quotes.what: CoinMarketCap quotes for SOL (id 5426) and BNB (id 1839): price, rank, market cap, dominance, volume, % changes (BTC & ETH dashboard, SOL/BNB views)

snap/coinglass_sol.what: CoinGlass SOL funding, open interest and liquidations (read in the browser)

snap/coinglass_bnb.what: CoinGlass BNB funding, open interest and liquidations (read in the browser)
